title: Bound global Multi-Site generated routes and destinations

opportunity.rootCause: Per-Site cardinality limits did not bound the aggregate runtime topology. Generated routes multiply normalized Hostnames by normalized PathPrefixes, while generated destinations aggregate Upstreams across all active Sites.
opportunity.risk: A valid collection of many Sites could still expand the YARP configuration provider and route/destination graph to an excessive size during activation.

implementation.behavior: Both IConfiguration validation and typed snapshot validation now reject aggregate route or destination counts above the configured global limits before SiteProxyConfiguration.Build runs.

red.result: failed 2/2 because neither global topology gate existed

verification.multiSiteRegression: passed 263/263 across 99 executable test classes; external PostgreSQL fault-injection and non-test filename placeholders were not executable suite classes

boundary: PostgreSQL-backed integration and live large-topology activation were not run in this environment
Authenticated browser and published-EXE smoke were not run
Visual responsive, screen-reader, CodeQL/SARIF, external penetration, load/SLO, SIEM, Authenticode, and production certification remain unverified
